description: Compile an EmailContent JSON object (the shape used by the Send16 builder + templates) into HTML using the platform's authoritative renderer. Returns the exact HTML the API would send. Useful for previews and post-processing.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

content.description: EmailContent JSON (from get_template or the builder)

name: render_email_content
